summary: Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V., a Dutch foreign private issuer listed on Euronext Amsterdam, furnished a Form 6-K on 24 September 2026 containing a stock-exchange announcement titled 'Share Purchase - Long Term Incentive Plans.' Between 18 and 23 September 2026 the company bought 1,380,960 ordinary shares on-market via Euronext, CBOE, Equiduct and Aquis at average daily prices of roughly EUR 16.54-16.96, part of a previously announced plan to acquire up to 6.6 million shares to cover long-term incentive obligations. This is routine buyback execution for employee share plans, not a special situation; investors should monitor remaining programme capacity and future disclosure of purchases.
